stage0082_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I heard from $$加持$$.
　...You're going to see father, right?」

stage0082_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That guy... telling him more than he needed to...」

stage0082_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Because I don't want to keep
　not knowing things anymore, either」

stage0082_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シンジ$$
「The reason I have to pilot the EVA...
　The reason father needs me...
　I want to understand that」

stage0082_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$加持$$ asked me to.
　To look after $$ミサト$$ for him」

stage0082_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It's nothing.
　I'll be counting on you, $$シンジ$$」

stage0082_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$竜馬$$
「How are things looking in Dakar?」

stage0082_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$シモン$$
「Seems the Federation Forces intend
　to just watch and wait.」

stage0082_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$キタン$$
「Why the hell not?
　If they know Neo Zeon's coming,
　they should just meet 'em with a big force!」

stage0082_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$隼人$$
「Right now in Dakar, the moderates,
　led by the Earth Federation $$大統領$$,
　are apparently holding some meeting.」

stage0082_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$隼人$$
「That's exactly what's happening.
　EFF Supreme Command, run by Chrono now,
　means to let the $$大統領$$ and the others die.」

stage0082_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it!
　We pushed ourselves too hard last mission,
　and now we still can't move...」

stage0082_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$隼人$$
「A military faction against Supreme
　Command, and $$プリベンター$$, have spared
　some troops. It's them and Londo Bell now.」

stage0082_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't tell me you're psychic, $$いぶき$$...?」

stage0082_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$いぶき$$
「I'm worried enough to distract myself
　with a dumb joke」

stage0082_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$青山$$
「There's no use us worrying about it.
　It's an issue between $$シンジ$$ and his old man」

stage0082_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$赤木$$
「Still, those two are a bit...」

stage0082_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That's not something outsiders should
　say. It's between parent and child」

stage0082_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$赤木$$
「As expected, $$いぶき$$...!
　A true veteran of father conflicts!」

stage0082_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$赤木$$
「What is it?
　Going quiet all of a sudden...」

stage0082_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$いぶき$$
「It's nothing.
　...There's no use us worrying about it, either」

stage0082_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$いぶき$$
（Every parent and child relationship is different,
　but when a parent's love doesn't come across right,
　it only ends up pushing the child further away...）

stage0082_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$いぶき$$
（I wonder if it'll be okay...
　That Commander Ikari seems... pretty
　clumsy about that kind of thing...）

stage0082_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$隼人$$
「Still, I hope this at least shows us a piece
　of NERV's mystery」

stage0082_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah.
　That four-eyed guy's habit of holding
　everything in reminds me of old man Saotome」

stage0082_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Don't think my eyes are just for show, $$シモン$$.
　What's really on your mind is the EVA.」

stage0082_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「No... you could say you fear it」

stage0082_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ギミー$$
「What's wrong!?
　I can't believe $$シモン$$ would be scared of anything!」

stage0082_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$キタン$$
「That ain't like you, $$シモン$$.
　Aren't you the guy who never flinches,
　no matter how big the enemy is?」

stage0082_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$シモン$$
「If it's an enemy, I just clash with it head-on.
　But that thing...」

stage0082_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$シモン$$
「I can't explain it, but that thing is dangerous...
　Something about it is fundamentally
　different from other machines.」

stage0082_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$隼人$$
「Something inside you is sounding the alarm...」

stage0082_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$シモン$$
「If it's about machines that make no sense,
　Aquarion, $$ジェニオン$$, and Unicorn are
　all just as strange...」

stage0082_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$シモン$$
「But the EVA... that Unit-01,
　something about it's different...」

stage0082_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ニア$$
（It's because you are the same kind of being.）

stage0082_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?」

stage0082_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$キタン$$
「Pull it together, $$シモン$$.
　What good are you like that?」

stage0082_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「It's only natural that you'd be on edge.」

stage0082_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$n
「$$アドヴェント$$...!
　Why are you here!?」

stage0082_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I came to warn you of danger.」

stage0082_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シモン$$
「Does that danger have something to do
　with what you just said about me being on edge?」

stage0082_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$シモン$$...
　When your head is held down, you draw out
　the strength to break through it...」

stage0082_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Now that the whole world is being wrapped
　in the Prison of Time, that sense of confinement
　is instead awakening your power.」

stage0082_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let's hurry.
　He may already be closing in.」

stage0082_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Yes.
　The Human Instrumentality Project behind
　the Angel intercepts, and what the EVA series means...」

stage0082_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Along with the relationship between NERV,
　its parent organization, and Chrono...
　As field commander, I demand an explanation」

stage0082_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Chrono...
　And to think father and the others were involved too...）

stage0082_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I see...
　So you're saying you can't fight without knowing anything」

stage0082_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「There's no need for an explanation」

stage0082_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Did you not hear me, Colonel Katsuragi?」

stage0082_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's not something $$ミサト$$ or I can accept」

stage0082_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm sick of it.
　Fighting without understanding anything,
　without being told anything...!」

stage0082_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Then get out of the EVA」

stage0082_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Is that really okay with you, father?」

stage0082_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「You have no purpose once you leave the EVA.
　Go home」

stage0082_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Please wait, Commander Ikari.
　Isn't that a bit much for $$シンジ$$,
　after all he's fought through?」

stage0082_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I'll acknowledge what's been done until today.
　$$シンジ$$ has done well」

stage0082_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「But things change from tomorrow.
　The EVA series will be pulled out of $c」

stage0082_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ニア$$
「Are you going to revise the plan
　in response to the schedule delay?」

stage0082_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ニア$$
「And so, you seek evolution, don't you?」

stage0082_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$シンジ$$
「How did you get in here!?」

stage0082_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ニア$$
「It's to tell you all of despair」

stage0082_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I see...
　So you're their messenger」

stage0082_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ニア$$
「I'll say it again.
　I came to tell you all of despair」

stage0082_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$カヲル$$
（Fate has shifted, if only a little...）

stage0082_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$カヲル$$
（This should mean no Angels will appear for a while）

stage0082_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$カヲル$$
「A bit of a shame...
　It seems my visit to see him
　will be delayed too」

stage0082_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「To think you'd turn yourself in」

stage0082_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Insubordination, and unauthorized
　use of an EVA... Both are crimes.
　...Do you have anything to say?」

stage0082_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I did it because I thought it was necessary」

stage0082_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「That judgment is mine to make」

stage0082_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$シンジ$$
「And if you're wrong, what am I
　supposed to do?」

stage0082_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I am stripping you of your qualification
　as an EVA pilot」

stage0082_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「And if I said that, what would
　you do?」

stage0082_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Even without an EVA, I'll find
　something I can do」

stage0082_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「...Paying any price to fulfill your
　own wish, by your own strength...
　Is that your idea of becoming an adult?」

stage0082_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't want to become the kind of
　adult who steals someone's happiness
　or life to get there」

stage0082_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「This entire incident will be excused
　as a judgment call made in the field
　by the pilot」

stage0082_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The three EVAs will continue to operate
　under $c, as before.
　I leave command to you」

stage0082_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It's fine.
　A delay of this scale was expected」

stage0082_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$冬月$$
「So you'll let things run their course...」

stage0082_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「And that's only for another month」

stage0082_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$冬月$$
「At the $$大統領$$s' meeting in Dakar, it was
　decided that on November 1st, the truth of
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$ will be told to all mankind」

stage0082_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$冬月$$
「By then, the abnormality will be plain
　to anyone's eyes anyway」

stage0082_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Then, we shall watch how things unfold.
　Until the time of evolution... the day
　of Instrumentality...」

stage0082_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$シモン$$
「What a pathetic face.
　You're the guy who talked that big,
　aren't you」

stage0082_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シモン$$'s tough, isn't he」

stage0082_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$ニア$$... There's someone
　waiting for me」

stage0082_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$赤木$$
「Same goes for you, $$シンジ$$.
　Everyone was waiting for you
　to come back」

stage0082_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$甲児$$
「If your old man had talked you into
　staying, we were all gonna go drag
　you back ourselves」

stage0082_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$n
「I believed $$シンジ$$ would come back
　on his own」

stage0082_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$葵$$
「Of course.
　$$シンジ$$'s a member of $c, after all」

stage0082_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$タケル$$
「Painful things, sad things, hard things,
　we've all gotten through them together」

stage0082_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Helping each other, being helped
　in turn」

stage0082_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Your hot soul, it hit me hard」

stage0082_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$桂$$
「Even that cranky old man was
　caught off guard」

stage0082_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's about time you flew the nest
　from your father's protection」

stage0082_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You're a full-grown man now,
　$$シンジ$$」

stage0082_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「We're not the only ones who were
　waiting for $$シンジ$$」

stage0082_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Now, remember your promise.
　Hurry up and get dinner ready」

stage0082_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Goodbye, father...
　I don't know what I can do, but
　I'll go looking for it...）

stage0082_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$n
「...Am I unable to beat $$ガドライト$$...」

stage0082_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$n
「To cover for my inexperience,
　even $$アドヴェント$$ got hurt...」

stage0082_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry.
　The $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ simply can't
　measure up to the $$ジェミニア$$...」

stage0082_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$n
「No, that's not it.
　The real difference isn't the machines,
　it's the gap in skill between him and me」

stage0082_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, is that all!
　You get it after all!」

stage0082_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Making such a serious face was a waste.
　If you know why you lost,
　let's hurry up and fix it」

stage0082_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've got that drunken bastard's fighting
　style fully logged as data.
　We can run a simulation match right away」

stage0082_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$n
「That helps.
　...Let's get right to it, then」

stage0082_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$n
「$$シモン$$ hasn't lost hope either...
　I'll... show what I can do too」

stage0082_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Even the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ can't beat him...
　And even that $$アドヴェント$$ wasn't enough...
　That despair will strike $n...）

stage0082_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（But as it grows stronger, so does its
　opposite... a search for hope...
　That will surely lift $n higher one day）

stage0082_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（That became a Z-Chip worth 100Z.
　I'll add it to the squad's stock）

stage0082_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Please do your best, $n.
　You and Miss $$スズネ$$ are hope to me too...）

stage0082_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（To help $n and Master $$シモン$$ do
　their best, I stocked some special
　goods too. I hope it aids you ahead）

stage0082_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$マリ$$
「$$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$...
　But you can forget that name.
　I won't be showing my face again」

stage0082_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why is that phantom EVA pilot
　here?」

stage0082_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$マリ$$
「A little trick of fate led to
　this turn of events, but really,
　I should've been fighting in $c too...」

stage0082_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$マリ$$
「Anyway, long story short, I just
　came to show my face」

stage0082_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　I don't quite follow, but
　welcome, for now」

stage0082_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$マリ$$
「So this is my one and only
　appearance here! I'm gonna go
　all out without holding back!」

stage0082_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood!
　This $$ＡＧ$$ will go all out too!」

stage0082_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's get fired up today too!!」

stage0082_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$マリ$$
「Business, business!
　And bye-bye while I'm at it!」
